title: Batch manifest
description: One variant's batch manifest, batches/<variant>/manifest.json, written by build-cards (src/dont_say_oyster/cards.py) and checked by check_manifests there. Fields: SPEC.md, Implementation, Experiment result format (models, the Ollama server version, variant, card set, card order, num_ctx, temperature, thinking on/off). build-cards writes the variant, the cards file, and the card order, and carries settings and ollama_version forward from the manifest it replaces; the four manifests hold the same card order, settings, and ollama_version, which check_manifests checks across them.

thinking.description: play-game's thinking argument for the role, not Ollama's think value.

cards.description: The cards file, relative to the repo root when it is inside it.

card_ids.description: The forty card ids in card order.

temperature.description: The one temperature of every role (SPEC.md, Implementation, Temperature policy).

settings.description: The settings play-game runs the batch with: the record's settings without keep_alive, which is not a manifest field.

ollama_version.description: The Ollama server version, the bare number /api/version returns.
